name: mcp-vision-bridge
description: Give your text-only coding agent (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen, Kimi) vision. Adds an analyze_image MCP tool that routes images through any multimodal model (mimo, Claude, Gemini, GPT-4o) and returns a detailed text description. Paste or drag in one or many images — analyzed in a single call, scoped to the current session. Includes a vision skill and an auto-loop hook that detects pasted images and guides the agent to analyze them.
